typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	G_Dw_Run_Key as integer (),
	Stg_DataQuery as string ()
}

source(output(
		CardNo as string,
		HolderNo as string,
		HolderName as string,
		IODate as date,
		IOTime as string,
		IOGateNo as string,
		IOGateName as string,
		IOStatus as string,
		DepartmentNo as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT     CardNo, HolderNo, HolderName, IODate, IOTime, IOGateNo, IOGateName, IOStatus, DepartmentNo FROM         IOData WHERE     (CardNo NOT LIKE \'%XXXX%\') AND (DepartmentNo = \'01\')',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> DSRIODATA	source(output(
		Holder_Number as string,
		EmployeeID as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'select Holder_Number,EmployeeID from dbo.DIM_HOLDER',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> LKPEmpIDLKPTABLE
DSRIODATA derive({Copy of IODate} = IODate,
		{Copy of HolderNo} = HolderNo) ~> DCHolderNumber
DCHolderNumber,LKPEmpIDLKPTABLE lookup({Copy of HolderNo} == Holder_Number,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> LKPEmpID
LKPEmpID filter(isMatch()) ~> LKPEmpID0
LKPEmpID0 derive(G_Dw_Run_Key = $G_Dw_Run_Key,
		IOStatus = iif(iif(iif(iif((IOGateNo == '13-4'), 'Exit', (IOGateNo == '14-2')), 'Exit', (IOGateNo == '13-8')), 'Entry', (IOGateNo == '14-6')), 'Entry', IOStatus)) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn derive({Copy of EmployeeID} = toLong(EmployeeID),
		IODate = toString(IODate)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		CardNo as string,
		HolderName as string,
		IOTime as string,
		IOGateNo as string,
		DepartmentNo as string,
		HolderNo as string,
		IOGateName as string,
		IOStatus as string,
		DW_Run_Key as integer,
		EmployeeID as integer,
		IODate as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		CardNo,
		HolderName,
		IOTime,
		IOGateNo,
		DepartmentNo,
		HolderNo,
		IOGateName,
		IOStatus,
		DW_Run_Key = G_Dw_Run_Key,
		EmployeeID = {Copy of EmployeeID},
		IODate)) ~> OLEDBDestination
